variableDeclarations.name: out_of_scope
variableDeclarations.description:
Tracks consecutive out-of-scope user requests.
Reset to 0 whenever the user makes an in-scope request.
Escalate only after 3 consecutive out-of-scope requests.

variableDeclarations.name: out_of_scope_count
variableDeclarations.description:
Tracks consecutive out-of-scope user requests.
Increment by 1 for each consecutive out-of-scope request.
Reset to 0 when the user makes an in-scope request.
Escalate to Human Escalation when the count reaches 3.
